hero.heroTagline: Creativity that begins today, creates an impact that lasts forever

explore.label: The Academy
explore.body: The Academy of Arts stands at the intersection of Egypt's ancient cultural heritage and its evolving contemporary expression. Our eight higher institutes offer rigorous conservatory training across every performing discipline, united by a shared belief: art is not ornament — it is the substance of civilization.
explore.pillar1Desc: Rigorous conservatory training across every performing discipline, guided by Egypt's foremost practitioners.
explore.pillar2Desc: Advancing scholarship in Arabic heritage, contemporary theory, and the intersection of tradition and innovation.
explore.pillar3Desc: Partnerships with leading institutions across Europe, the Arab world, and beyond — opening doors globally.

institutes.label: Our Disciplines
institutes.headline: Eight Higher Institutes
institutes.theatricalDesc: Directing, acting, dramatic writing, and theatre criticism.
institutes.cinemaDesc: Filmmaking, screenwriting, cinematography, and production design.
institutes.balletDesc: Classical and contemporary dance, choreography, and pedagogy.
institutes.musicDesc: Performance, composition, and the Arabic maqam tradition.
institutes.dramaticDesc: Arabic dramatic heritage, folk performance, and critical theory.
institutes.folkDesc: Egypt's intangible cultural heritage — music, dance, storytelling.

admissions.label: Join Us
admissions.headline: Begin Your Artistic Journey
admissions.subtitle: Applications are now open for the 2026–27 academic year across all institutes and programmes.
admissions.undergraduateDesc: Four-year programmes across all eight institutes. Open to Egyptian and international applicants with a secondary school qualification.
admissions.postgraduateDesc: MA and PhD tracks in performance practice, critical theory, and arts administration. Research and practical pathways available.
admissions.internationalDesc: Dedicated pathways for non-Egyptian applicants including scholarships, cultural exchange programmes, and language support.
